conclusions: Worldgroup global command callbacks execute before module-local input handlers in the normal input path.
Global command registration and dispatch preserve FIFO order and use explicit negative control values.
MajorMUD registers a concrete module descriptor and stores the returned Worldgroup module index for later host-facing operations.
Worldgroup selects one of three module input callbacks by session state; this closes the host-side player-command dispatch boundary to the MajorMUD callback entry points.
The internal MajorMUD semantics of the callback bodies remain a separate native-module trace and are not invented here.
